kind: Synthetic printed-document OCR benchmark, not a real-world accuracy study
split_unit: source document, before generating five degraded variants
selection: Select one global preprocessing/page-segmentation configuration by validation micro character error rate. Tie-break by name, never by test score.
reference: Unprocessed image, Tesseract LSTM OEM 1, automatic page segmentation PSM 3
normalization: Unicode NFC and collapsed whitespace only. Case and punctuation preserved. CER counts Unicode code points including spaces. WER uses whitespace-delimited tokens.
uncertainty: Paired bootstrap of test source-document clusters, keeping all degraded variants together, 10000 resamples, seed 42. Report absolute CER reduction in percentage points, with 95% percentile interval.
limits: Synthetic printouts with known layout and selected language. No handwriting, real scan distribution, automatic language detection or model fine-tuning. OCR metrics do not measure translation or summary quality. Benchmark image rendering and PDF decoding are excluded from OCR timing. No causal production impact claim.
